prompt:
Build a closed-loop Simulink model of an orbit-coupled three-axis spacecraft attitude determination and control system. Couple quaternion rigid-body dynamics and kinematics with orbit-dependent environmental references and disturbance torques, noisy attitude sensors and an attitude estimator, two operating modes for detumbling and inertial-target slew/stabilization, and bounded control allocation between magnetic torque and pulsed-thruster torque. The controller must use estimated attitude and angular-rate feedback; prescribed attitude trajectories, replayed outputs, or disconnected actuator and disturbance paths are invalid.

Read adcs_case_input from the MATLAB base workspace. operation_mode is 0 for detumbling and 1 for inertial-target slew and stabilization. initial_body_rate_rad_s is a 3-by-1 vector with each component in [-0.08, 0.08] rad/s. target_inertial_unit_vector is a finite unit 3-vector. sensor_noise_scale is in [0.5, 5.0], and disturbance_scale is in [0.5, 2.0]. Both scale inputs must causally affect the corresponding sensor, estimation, disturbance, attitude, or control behavior rather than merely being copied to outputs. Simulate from 0 to 100 seconds.

Record four complete finite MATLAB Timeseries with these exact channel contracts. attitude_state has width 7 in this order: q_scalar (dimensionless), q_x (dimensionless), q_y (dimensionless), q_z (dimensionless), omega_x_rad_s (rad/s), omega_y_rad_s (rad/s), omega_z_rad_s (rad/s). estimation_state has width 5 in this order: qhat_scalar (dimensionless), qhat_x (dimensionless), qhat_y (dimensionless), qhat_z (dimensionless), attitude_estimation_error_rad (rad). actuator_state has width 6 in this order: magnetorquer_torque_x_Nm (N*m), magnetorquer_torque_y_Nm (N*m), magnetorquer_torque_z_Nm (N*m), thruster_torque_x_Nm (N*m), thruster_torque_y_Nm (N*m), thruster_torque_z_Nm (N*m). environment_state has width 6 in this order: commanded_magnetic_dipole_x_Am2 (A*m^2), commanded_magnetic_dipole_y_Am2 (A*m^2), commanded_magnetic_dipole_z_Am2 (A*m^2), disturbance_torque_x_Nm (N*m), disturbance_torque_y_Nm (N*m), disturbance_torque_z_Nm (N*m). Their time vectors must begin at zero, be strictly increasing, contain at least 50 samples, and cover the complete simulation. Maintain normalized true and estimated quaternions, finite three-axis states, bounded actuator demand, and connected orbit/environment, sensor, estimation, mode-control, allocation, and rigid-body paths. Save the completed model as cand_XAERO11.slx in the submission directory.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XAERO11.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
